prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — the right AI video ad maker depends on your goals (presenter vs. animated, social short-form vs. longer product demos, budget, languages). Below are the top tools by use case and why you’d pick each.

Top picks (quick overview)
- Synthesia — Best for presenter-driven ads using realistic AI spokespeople and many languages. Great when you want a human-looking presenter without hiring actors.
- HeyGen (and Elai.io) — Similar to Synthesia; typically cheaper, with good presenter and voice options.
- InVideo — Best all-rounder for marketers: lots of templates, easy editing, text-to-video features, social aspect ratios, and rapid output.
- Pictory — Best for repurposing long-form content into short ads and for automated captioning/subtitles.
- Lumen5 — Simple, fast text-to-video optimized for social posts and captions.
- Runway — Best for advanced creative/generative video editing (background replacement, inpainting, generative fills). More creative power, steeper learning curve.
- Promo.com (and SproutVideo/Animoto) — Good for quick licensed-footage ad templates and rights-cleared music; fast for high-volume social ads.
- Viddyoze — Best for animated intros/outros and motion graphics.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Want a realistic on-screen presenter? Go Synthesia/HeyGen/Elai.
- Need many short social versions, captions, templates, and speed? Go InVideo, Lumen5, or Promo.
- Repurposing webinars/podcasts into multiple short ads? Pictory.
- Need advanced generative editing or creative control? Runway.
- Want animated logos/intros or product reveals? Viddyoze or Promo.

Pricing & trials
- Most offer free trials or free tiers with watermarks; Synthesia/HeyGen and Runway are subscription-based with usage limits or credits. InVideo/Lumen5 have affordable monthly plans aimed at marketers.

My recommendation
- If you want one tool to make most types of social ads quickly: start with InVideo (templates + simple AI features).
- If you need a convincing human presenter: choose Synthesia or HeyGen.
- If you need powerful generative editing for high-end creative work: choose Runway.

If you tell me: 1) platform (Facebook/Instagram/Reels/YouTube/LinkedIn), 2) style (real presenter, animated, text-over-stock footage), 3) budget, and 4) whether you need many variants, I’ll recommend the single best tool for your situation and can suggest a template/script.
